# Northwind Support Operations

## Incident response

Severity One incidents are production outages affecting all customers. The on-call team must
acknowledge a Severity One incident within 15 minutes and post status updates every 30 minutes.

Severity Two incidents affect a subset of customers. The acknowledgement target is 60 minutes.

## Ownership

The Reliability Engineering team owns the incident process. Customer Support owns customer
communications while an incident is active.
